metaDescription: CPT 99496 explained: Transitional Care Management with high complexity and a visit within 7 days of discharge. Deadlines, rules and 2026 rate.
summary: The higher TCM code: high-complexity decision-making and a face-to-face visit within 7 days of discharge.
time: Contact within 2 business days; visit within 7 days
performer: Practitioner for the visit; clinical staff for outreach
frequency: Once per patient in the 30 days after discharge
requirements: Interactive contact within 2 business days of discharge
A face-to-face visit within 7 calendar days
Medication reconciliation on or before the visit date
pitfalls: Using 99496 when the visit actually happened on day 8 to 14
conflicts: Only one TCM code is reported per patient per 30-day period.

faqs.question: Which TCM code applies if the visit is on day 10?
faqs.answer: 99496 requires a visit within 7 days. A day 10 visit fits 99495, provided the other requirements are met.

faqs.question: Is 99496 paid more than 99495?
faqs.answer: Yes. It reflects higher complexity and a tighter timeline, with a higher national rate. Actual amounts vary by locality.
